title: Stop later processing
summary: Phoenix: Stop later processing. Change the public message.
introduction: halt marks the connection so later plugs stop. Open GET /closed.

blocks.text: Create an app named school with mix phx.new school --no-ecto --no-html --no-assets. Enter school and run mix deps.get. Put each labelled section in its named file, then run mix phx.server. Use http://127.0.0.1:4000.

blocks.title: Stop later processing
blocks.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
get "/closed", LessonController, :closed
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def closed(conn, _params), do: conn |> send_resp(403, "Closed for practice") |> halt()
end

blocks.text: send_resp writes the 403 body. halt then marks the connection to stop later plugs.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: halt does not itself send a response; send it first.
